notes.note: docs/ui/responsive-action-surfaces.txt: the Details sheet no longer has an action strip of its own (its ChatInboxHoverCard.tsx entry is removed); the row's remaining touch actions are a menu list on the shared menu primitive, described and evidenced under the ChatDockInboxRows.tsx entry. An intermediate commit in this round left the inventory with a stale entry and the responsive ratchet failing; it passes at this revision (151 action surfaces). This document does not enumerate inventory entries, so its text stands.
